verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The pack documents REST-style Alerts, Case, listing and filing APIs and an llms.txt help index. Those are developer building blocks and adjacent features, not an MCP server, and the developer docs are password-gated with no public spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
